sections.title: Why Hire SOS as Your Laguna Niguel Moving Company
sections.content: Laguna Niguel was among California's first master-planned communities, and today it is home to a long list of homeowner associations, several guard-gated enclaves and hillside streets across the San Joaquin Hills. We plan every move here around the gate, the grade and the association's rules, backed by a 4.9 rating from 1,007 Google reviews. Built for gates, slopes and HOAs: Gate-ready arrival: Share your community's guest-list or vendor instructions when you book, and we time the crew's arrival to fit the association's rules. Hillside carries: Stairs, long carries from the curb and multiple stops are included in the hourly rate, so a steep driveway or terraced entry adds no charge. Clear rates: Monday–Thursday start at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck at the cash rate, Friday–Sunday are $135/hr, and a $30 gas fee applies. Every move is handled under CPUC license CAL-T0192140, USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation.

sections.title: Piano Movers in Laguna Niguel, CA
sections.content: Getting an upright down a run of garden steps or a grand out of a split-level living room takes planning at both ends of the move. As professional piano movers in Laguna Niguel, CA, we wrap, carry and place your instrument, and the piano specialty fee is $200, added to the hourly rate. How your piano moves with us: Full wrap: Moving blankets and shrink wrap cover the case, legs and pedals before the piano leaves the room. Steps and slopes: Stairs, terraced walkways and long carries to where the truck can park are covered by the hourly rate, with no surcharge. Set in place: We reassemble anything we took apart and set the piano exactly where you want it in the new home. Packing up the rest of the house as well? Our packing services handle kitchens, books and closets, and white glove care is available for art and antiques.

sections.title: Moving Around Laguna Niguel and South County
sections.content: Crown Valley Parkway runs through the heart of Laguna Niguel, and the city shares borders with Mission Viejo, Aliso Viejo, Laguna Hills, San Juan Capistrano, Dana Point and Laguna Beach. Moves across town or into any of those neighbors are billed by the hour as local moves, while anything headed out of state goes to our long-distance crew. Included at the hourly rate: Supplies: Moving blankets, shrink wrap, packing tape and wardrobe boxes come on the truck at no added cost. Setup: Crews take furniture apart and put it back together, unmount TVs, place each piece where you want it and help you unpack. Same-day moves: If your closing date moves up, same-day service is available based on crew availability. Longer local moves are billed with Double Drive Time under CPUC rules, and moves leaving California are handled by our long-distance movers.

sections.title: Leaving Laguna Niguel for Another State
sections.content: Texas, Nevada and Arizona draw more Californians than any other states, and we take Laguna Niguel households there from packing day through delivery. Interstate moves run under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871. Routes we plan from Laguna Niguel: Texas: The top destination for Californians moving out of state, with full packing available before the truck leaves. Arizona & Nevada: Close behind Texas on that list, with storage available if your new home isn't ready on move-out day. Heading north: The interstate along Laguna Niguel's eastern edge runs north through Sacramento to Portland and Seattle. Staying closer to home? Our local moving service covers South County, while this team focuses on out-of-state and cross-country routes.

sections.title: Office Moves in Laguna Niguel
sections.content: Moving out of the Crown Cabot Financial Center, another office in the Gateway area along Cabot and Forbes Roads, or a storefront elsewhere in Laguna Niguel? Our commercial movers pack and move desks, files and equipment, with crews scheduled Monday through Sunday.

faq.question: Can your movers get through the gate at Monarch Point, Bear Brand Ranch or San Joaquin Hills?
faq.answer: Yes, once you add SOS Moving to your community's guest or vendor list before moving day. Associations set their own rules on entry, truck hours and parking, so check your CC&Rs or ask your management company and pass the details to us. We then schedule the crew's arrival to fit your association's move hours.

faq.question: Do stairs or a steep driveway on a Laguna Niguel hillside lot cost extra?
faq.answer: No. Stairs, long carries from wherever the truck can park and multiple stops are all part of the hourly rate. Charged on top are the $30 gas fee and specialty work — a piano is $200 and needs a four-mover crew, an item over 300 lbs is $150 — plus extras such as a certificate of insurance or an additional truck if your building or your move needs one.

faq.question: How much do piano movers in Laguna Niguel, CA charge?
faq.answer: SOS Moving adds a $200 piano specialty fee to the hourly rate for your move. Stairs and long carries on hillside properties are already included, so a flight of front steps doesn't raise that figure. When you book, tell us whether it's an upright or a grand and describe the path in and out so we can plan the move.

faq.question: Is a move from Laguna Niguel to Mission Viejo or Dana Point billed by the hour?
faq.answer: Monday–Thursday moves start at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck at the cash rate, and Friday–Sunday moves are $135/hr. A $30 gas fee applies, and the $50 deposit that holds your date is applied toward the total cost. Double Drive Time applies to longer local moves under CPUC rules, while long-distance moves out of state are quoted separately.

faq.question: Do you have an office in Laguna Niguel, and can you move me the same day?
faq.answer: No. SOS Moving works out of its headquarters at 5530 Jillson Street, Los Angeles, CA 90040, and serves Laguna Niguel from there. Same-day moves are possible when a crew is free — call 909-443-0004 and we will tell you what is open.
